Only engagement was a bug complaint (tick_bb83f93d02e1), now closed. Silent, disengaged pattern with 8 days left suggests low unaided activation.

draft.subject: Next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

You created your first project last week, which is the main thing — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. I hope the mobile save button issue you raised is settled now; the ticket is closed on our side, so just say the word if anything's still off.

The usual next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Priya
